Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this expression is redundant because 古代 already names a time period. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子：带着孩子，this expresses that the mother moves together with and takes the child along; 跟孩子搬家 is not the expected wording here. [vocab list]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，别的 distinguishes other things from a specifically mentioned one, while 另一个 means one additional/different city. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，first mentions should introduce the character clearly with a name and identity before using a shorter reference. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，孟子 was named in the immediately previous sentence and no other male character competes with him, so a pronoun is more natural for a close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在一个城市里，this city has not been introduced before, so its first mention needs an indefinite full noun phrase rather than 那个. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，孟母 is already the subject of this sentence, so a pronoun is the natural close re-occurrence in the result clause. [rule: none]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠近墓地的家里，住 is a continuing living state here, so it does not take 了; 在 must come before the location phrase. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，每天 shows a routine, so the verb takes the zero aspect particle rather than 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬家了，this move is presented as a completed past event, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
11. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到：搬到了，了 follows the resultative complement 到, not the main verb before it. [teacher rule: le_placement]

items.reason: 古代已经表示时间段，古代的时候重复，改为在古代正确。
跟孩子搬家本身可以表示和孩子一起搬家，并非用词错误。
别一个城市不符合这里“另一个城市”的意思，另一个城市正确。
孟子首次出现需要较清楚地介绍，但改后的文字以“他和妈妈”结尾，单独显示并不完整。
孩子在这里指代不够明确，孟子刚被提到后用他也能清楚地指代他。
城市尚未首次引入，那个城市不合适，改为一个城市里正确。
害得孟母没有钱语法正确，紧接着重复孟母虽然不如用她自然，但不构成必须改的错误。
住表示持续状态不应加了，而且在应放在地点短语前；改句正确。
每天表示习惯性行为，祭拜不应在这里使用完成体了。
这里叙述的是已经发生的搬家事件，加了能正确表示完成。
了应放在结果补语到之后，搬到了符合正确的补语和了的位置。
